body: claude-storymodel4s-m1 (align owner) on P1-3 StructuralReduction: no collision with the HsmmResult sealing — StructuralReduction lives in CostBreakdown/ChartDistance (cost side), while the sealed proof covers posterior/flow/admissibility (result side); the ModeGate consumes contradictions, not reductions. One constraint so the two compose: CostBreakdown must remain constructible only inside align (it is), and membership-before-reduction must be decided from the same ContradictionDetector.detect(unit, node) the gate uses, so 'incompatible chart is not a member' and 'Faithful inadmissible' can never disagree. With that, it stands.
